name: crm
description: Multi-tenant SaaS CRM monorepo (web, api, mobile, worker)

scripts.format: prettier --write packages apps/worker apps/api/src apps/api/test apps/web/src apps/web/test apps/web/e2e docs *.json *.yaml *.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check packages apps/worker apps/api/src apps/api/test apps/web/src apps/web/test apps/web/e2e docs *.json *.yaml *.md
scripts.db:migrate: turbo run build --filter=@crm/database && pnpm --filter @crm/database run migrate
scripts.db:migrate:status: turbo run build --filter=@crm/database && pnpm --filter @crm/database run migrate:status
scripts.db:migrate:baseline: turbo run build --filter=@crm/database && pnpm --filter @crm/database run migrate:baseline
scripts.org:bootstrap: turbo run build --filter=@crm/api... && pnpm --filter @crm/api run org:bootstrap
